effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your blue Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 blue Digimon for a memory cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait or [Koji Minamoto] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
